drawio_review_note: Aligned with Olmo 3 arXiv:2512.13961 Appendix A.7.2 Science QA. The Science QA entry in the Olmo 3 report describes scientific tool-use SFT data, not the older multimodal ScienceQA benchmark and not a separately scored evaluation suite. It has two query classes: paper-content questions grounded in abstracts or full text, and citation-graph questions about authors, venues, and citations. GPT-5 creates few-shot citation-query templates and instantiates them with real paper entities. For content questions, a GPT-5 agent uses the Ai2 Scholar Corpus server to retrieve papers and formulate questions answerable from the retrieved text. A GPT-4.1-mini agent with the same server then produces tool-use trajectories for both classes; the saved tool outputs are actual environment responses rather than synthetic completions. These trajectories enter Dolci Instruct SFT. The report does not separately disclose this subset's size, split, standalone scorer, or evaluation metric.
